newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise extends gains as Lehman rates buy.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise extends gains as Lehman rates buy.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc extended their advance on Thursday, bolstered by gains in U.S. oil shares overnight and a "buy" recommendation from brokerage Lehman Brothers, dealers said.
By 1015 GMT, Enterprise shares were up 12-1/2p to 637-1/2, marking the third consecutive session the shares rose.
Dealers said Lehman urged its clients to buy Enterprise shares earlier this week after having met with the company.
Analysts at Lehman weren't immediately available to comment.
Dealers said a steady dollar and crude oil prices holding above the $19.00 per barrel level lent support to the oil exploration group. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
